name: Neritic-Hypostyle
description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by magnetic pole anomalies. Farther poleward, past towering mountain ranges, the silence feels older than the soil.
Light is the weather here. It swings from merciful to murderous within an hour, and everyone schedules their lives around it.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
